name: peaking-fast
description: Focus peaking in colour, a faster colour loop. The pinned loop looks at every row and writes each line pixel byte by byte. The new loop T_FAST looks at every second row with 2 word reads per group of 4 pixels, and writes the colour over the whole group in that row and the next one with 6 word writes: the lines are drawn in blocks of 4 x 2 pixels. About 3 times fewer instructions and bus reads for a frame without lines, and about 10 times fewer bus accesses for the lines. White and Off do not change. A delta on builds/peaking-colours.json: every expect is a byte string of that build. See experiments/2026-11-14-focus-peaking/NOTES.md section 17.
_ram: no new RAM; 16 more bytes of the ART task's stack (40 in all)

ops._note: new code, kernel range, 0xFF run: T_FAST (117 B)

T_COL of peaking-colours, the first instructions of its row loop (`mov (sp),d0` / `mov a0,a2` / `add d0,a2`) -> `jmp T_FAST`
